name: ChannelPurger
summary: Removes left-over messages from a channel, so that what persisted from an earlier run does not get taken for a result of this one.

roles.name: ChannelPurger
roles.summary: The participant that empties a channel, or removes the messages matching some criterion. It exists because persistence outlives a test: a stale reply consumed as though it answered the request just sent is a bug that reproduces perfectly and explains nothing, and something that deletes messages on purpose is worth finding before it is pointed at production.
